scopeNotes: WSGC's current page says 23 tribes operate 29 casinos under compact but exposes 28 directory results. Current first-party evidence separately confirms both Elwha River Casino and Shoalwater Bay Casino are operating in 2026. Because Elwha River is Class II in NIGC material and therefore not necessarily counted in WSGC's compact total, the Dinner Roulette physical-destination scope contains 30 current tribal casino destinations: the 28 visible WSGC directory properties, Shoalwater Bay as the compact-directory reconciliation exception, and Elwha River as a current Class II destination. Commercial house-banked card rooms remain outside this tribal-casino pass.
